rules.title: Private key material indicator
evidenceRequirements: GitHub blob content pinned to the immutable scanned commit
Bounded text-eligible file selected by the repository baseline policy
rules.detectorLogic: Detect high-confidence PEM private-key boundary indicators without persisting the matched private-key material.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when the bounded detector observes a private-key material indicator.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for the indicator pattern in the inspected blob; repository-wide absence is not claimed when coverage is incomplete.
rules.messageTemplate: Private-key material indicators were observed in the bounded repository baseline.
rules.remediation: Remove exposed private-key material from the repository, rotate affected credentials where applicable, and review repository history and downstream copies.
rules.changelog: v1: initial bounded private-key indicator rule.

rules.title: GitHub token indicator
evidenceRequirements: GitHub blob content pinned to the immutable scanned commit
Bounded text-eligible file selected by the repository baseline policy
rules.detectorLogic: Detect supported high-confidence GitHub token formats; persist only indicator type, path and line rather than the matched token value.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when a supported GitHub token indicator is observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for supported token formats in inspected blobs; this is not a comprehensive secret-scanning guarantee.
rules.messageTemplate: A supported GitHub token indicator was observed in the bounded repository baseline.
rules.remediation: Revoke or rotate the affected token, remove it from the repository and history where necessary, and move secrets to an appropriate secret-management mechanism.
rules.changelog: v1: initial bounded GitHub-token indicator rule.

rules.title: AWS access key identifier indicator
evidenceRequirements: GitHub blob content pinned to the immutable scanned commit
Bounded text-eligible file selected by the repository baseline policy
rules.detectorLogic: Detect supported AWS access-key identifier formats; never persist the matched credential value.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when a supported AWS access-key identifier indicator is observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for supported identifier formats in inspected blobs; possession of a corresponding secret key is not inferred.
rules.messageTemplate: An AWS access-key identifier indicator was observed in the bounded repository baseline.
rules.remediation: Investigate the credential, rotate or disable it when exposure is possible, remove it from source/history as needed, and use workload identity or secret management instead.
rules.changelog: v1: initial bounded AWS access-key identifier rule.

rules.title: Stripe live secret key indicator
evidenceRequirements: GitHub blob content pinned to the immutable scanned commit
Bounded text-eligible file selected by the repository baseline policy
rules.detectorLogic: Detect supported Stripe live secret-key formats and persist only redacted indicator metadata.
rules.severityLogic: Critical when a supported Stripe live secret-key indicator is observed.
rules.confidenceLogic: High confidence for supported live-key formats in inspected blobs; unsupported formats and uninspected files remain outside coverage.
rules.messageTemplate: A Stripe live secret-key indicator was observed in the bounded repository baseline.
rules.remediation: Roll the exposed live key in Stripe, remove it from source/history, audit recent use and store replacement credentials outside the repository.
rules.changelog: v1: initial bounded Stripe-live-key indicator rule.
